ops.title: Land deep-predicate observers in dispatch with the cc-transcript pin bump (Lane C consumer)
ops.description:
The consumer half of fix C (Captain Hook note `d73db18`) sits uncommitted in the worktree `/Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/captain-hook/durable-predicate-batch-consumer-20261012` on branch `yasyf/durable-predicate-batch-consumer-20261012`, base `origin/main@d8108ea0`. It was written and reviewed by reading only. Nothing has been run: no pytest, ruff, ty or Go build.

What it does: during condition matching in `prepare_hook_events`, a dispatch-scoped plan lists the deep `UsedSkill`, `UsedTool` and literal `RanCommand` predicates of the candidate hooks. The first one demanded sends its same-scope siblings as `observers` on its `query_graph` request, and the transcript host answers them from the facts that walk loads. Definite answers are held under the existing scalar key and copied into the demanding lease's `scalar_results` on use. `ReadFile` and `TouchedFile` globs, regex `RanCommand`, custom conditions, hooks with an event window, mandatory hooks and handlers keep asking on their own.

Why it cannot land yet: cc-transcript 14.40.1 validates every request against the schema embedded in its wheel and rejects a `query_graph` that carries `observers` with `invalid_request`. That is not a fail-open status. The vendored schemas in this worktree (`captain_hook/snapshots/schemas`, `internal/snapshots/schema`) were regenerated from the new producer contract, so the CI step `Check generated snapshot schemas` in `.github/actions/python-tests/action.yml` stays red until the pin moves. Existing tests that dispatch two or more planned deep predicates against the real store will also fail against 14.40.1.

Landing order: cc-transcript lands and releases first (cc-transcript task `e723e1b`, note `a881eec`). Then this change lands in one commit with the `cc-transcript[judge]` pin and `uv.lock` moved to that release, and the changelog gains the pin line.

Files: `captain_hook/snapshots/client.py`, `captain_hook/snapshots/validation.py`, `captain_hook/conditions.py`, `captain_hook/dispatch.py`, `tests/test_predicate_observers.py` (new), the eight regenerated schema files, `CHANGELOG.md`.

This supersedes the pending batching choice in task `cd82ced` for the primary-observer design.

ops.text: A cc-transcript release that carries observers on query_graph exists, and pyproject.toml and uv.lock pin it in the same commit that lands this change
The Check generated snapshot schemas CI step passes for internal/snapshots/schema and captain_hook/snapshots/schemas against the installed cc_transcript package
uv run pytest tests/test_predicate_observers.py passes, and the existing snapshot client, prepared graph evidence and dispatch suites pass
A replay of N distinct root-negative deep predicates across hooks over one graph shows one child traversal in the host usage counters instead of N
